newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Russians still interested in Fokker - minister.
newsitem.headline: Russians still interested in Fokker - minister.

text.p: Russian aerospace group Yakovlev is still interested in a possible takeover of bankrupt Dutch plane maker Fokker, Russian Economy Minister Yevgeny Yasin said during a visit to the Netherlands on Monday.
Yasin, speaking through an interepreter, told reporters that Yakovlev representatives were still discussing a possible takeover with Fokker's court-appointed administrators.

The Russian group is generally regarded as having a remote chance of acuiring Fokker as South Korea's Samsung Aerospace has been given the exclusive right to examine Fokker's books with a view to a possible acquisition.
Samsung is expected to decide this week whether or not to take over Fokker.
Yakovlev has previously indicated that its takeover plans faced financial obstacles but Yasin said the company was close to securing a credit guarantee from the Russian government.
A group of Russian government experts recommended in September that the Russian government back an acquisition.
Yasin was visiting the Netherlands for talks with Dutch government officials and business leaders but he did not disclose details of his talks here.
